fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the profile photo, must be animated

fields.name: animation
fields.description: The animated profile photo. Profile photos can't be reused and can only be uploaded as a new file, so you can pass “attach://<file_attach_name>” if the photo was uploaded using multipart/form-data under <file_attach_name>. More information on Sending Files »

fields.name: main_frame_timestamp
fields.description: Timestamp in seconds of the frame that will be used as the static profile photo. Defaults to 0.0.

description: An animated profile photo in the MPEG4 format.
